responsibility: The legacy detector monitored a Cloudflare-specific latency stream and requested model resets after sustained distribution drift.
replacement: The generic Rill Runtime remains responsible only for bounded learner state and generic model-health signals; Cloudflare keeps native ranking authoritative.
hostSafety: Removing the detector cannot authorize host mutation. Runtime failure, unhealthy model state, or reset is handled as advisory failure and falls back to native ranking.
resetPolicy: Reset is explicit and state-generation checked; no automatic Cloudflare-specific reset is claimed by the consumer.
fallbackPolicy: Any missing, invalid, stale, rejected, or unhealthy Runtime result leaves the native candidate order and host transaction unchanged.
